verses.translation: And as to the sons of Issachar, they were Thola, and Phua, and Jasub, and Semeron, four.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Isahar au fost patru: Tola, Pua, Iaşub şi Şimron.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσσάχαρ, Θωλὰ, καὶ Φουὰ, καὶ Ἰασοὺβ, καὶ Σεμερὼν, τέσσαρες.

verses.translation: And the sons of Thola; Ozi, Raphaia, and Jeriel, and Jamai, and Jemasan, and Samuel, chiefs of their fathers' houses belonging to Thola, men of might according to their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty and two thousand and six hundred.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Tola au fost: Uzi, Refaia, Ieriil, Iahmai, Ibsam şi, Samuel; aceştia sunt cei mai de seamă în neamul lui Tola, oameni războinici în neamul lor; numărul lor în zilele lui David era douăzeci şi două de mii şi şase sute.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Θωλὰ, Ὀζὶ, Ῥαφαΐα, καὶ ʼΙεριὴλ, καὶ ʼΙαμαῒ, καὶ ʼΙεμασὰν, καὶ Σαμουὴλ, ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν τῷ Θωλὰ, ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν, ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέραις Δαυὶδ, εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ozi; Jezraia: and the sons of Jezraia; Michael, Abdiu, and Joel, and Jesia, five, all rulers.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Uzi a fost Izrahia; iar fiii lui Izrahia au fost: Micael, Obadia, Ioil şi Işia, de toţi cinci. Toţi aceştia sunt căpetenii.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ ʼΟζὶ, ʼΙεζραῒα· καὶ υἱοὶ ʼΙεζραΐ, Μιχαὴλ, ʼΑβδιοὺ, καὶ ʼΙωὴλ, καὶ ʼΙεσία, πέντε, ἄρχοντες πάντες.

verses.translation: And with them, according to their generations, according to the houses of their families, were men mighty to set armies in array for war, thirty and six thousand, for they had multiplied their wives and children.

translations.ron: Ei, după familiile lor şi după neamurile lor, aveau oştire de treizeci şi şase de mii de oameni, pentru că ei au avut multe femei şi mulţi copii.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπʼ αὐτῶν, κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν, κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν, ἰσχυροὶ παρατάξασθαι εἰς πόλεμον, τριάκοντα καὶ ἓξ χιλιάδες, ὅτι ἐπλήθυναν γυναῖκας καὶ υἱούς.

verses.translation: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, also mighty men, were eighty-seven thousand—this was the number of them all.

translations.ron: Iar fraţii lor, în toate neamurile lui Isahar, aveau oameni de luptă optzeci şi şapte de mii, înscrişi în tăbliţele cele cu spiţa neamului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν εἰς πάσας πατριὰς Ἰσσάχαρ, καὶ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, ὀγδοήκοντα καὶ ἑπτὰ χιλιάδες, ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν τῶν πάντων.

verses.translation: The sons of Benjamin; Bale, and Bachir, and Jediel, three.

translations.ron: Veniamin a avut trei: pe Bela, Becher şi Iediael (Aşbel).
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Βενιαμὶν, καὶ Βαλὲ, καὶ Βαχὶρ, καὶ ʼΙεδιὴλ, τρεῖς.

verses.translation: And the sons of Bale; Esebon, and Ozi, and Oziel, and Jerimuth, and Uri, five; heads of houses of families, mighty men; and their number was twenty and two thousand and thirty-four.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Bela au fost cinci: Eţbon, Uzi, Uziel, Ierimot şi Iri, toţi căpetenii de familii, oameni războinici. În tăbliţele cu spiţa neamului sunt înscrişi douăzeci şi două de mii treizeci şi patru.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Βαλὲ, ʼΕσεβὼν, καὶ Ὀζὶ, καὶ Ὀζιὴλ, καὶ Ἰεριμοὺθ, καὶ Οὐρὶ, πέντε, ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατρικῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει· καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν, εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες καὶ τριακοντατέσσαρες.

verses.translation: And the sons of Bachir; Zemira, and Joas, and Eliezer, and Elithenan, and Amaria, and Jerimuth, and Abiud, and Anathoth, and Eleemeth: all these were the sons of Bachir.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Becher au fost: Zemira, Ioaş, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Ieremot, Abia, Anatot şi Alemet; toţi aceştia sunt fiii lui Becher.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Βαχὶρ, Ζεμιρὰ, καὶ Ἰωὰς, καὶ Ἐλιέζερ, καὶ Ἐλιθενὰν, καὶ Ἀμαρία, καὶ ʼΙεριμοὺθ, καὶ Ἀβιοὺδ, καὶ Ἀναθὼθ, καὶ ʼΕληεμέθ· πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βαχίρ.

verses.translation: And their number according to their generations, (they were chiefs of their fathers' houses, men of might), was twenty thousand and two hundred.

translations.ron: În tăbliţele cu spiţa neamului sunt înscrişi din aceştia, după familiile şi după neamurile lor, oameni războinici douăzeci de mii şi două sute.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν, ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, εἴκοσι χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι.

verses.translation: And the sons of Jediel; Balaan: and the sons of Balaan; Jaüs, and Benjamin, and Aoth, and Chanana, and Zæthan, and Tharsi, and Achisaar.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Iediael (Aşbel) a fost Bilhan. Fiii lui Bilhan au fost: Ieuş, Veniamin, Ehud, Chenaana, Zetan, Tarşiş şi Ahişahar.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ ʼΙεδιὴλ, Βαλαάν· καὶ υἱοὶ Βαλαὰν, Ἰαοὺς, καὶ Βενιαμὶν, καὶ Ἀὼθ, καὶ Χανανὰ, καὶ Ζαιθὰν, καὶ Θαρσὶ, καὶ Ἀχισαάρ.

verses.translation: All these were the sons of Jediel, chiefs of their families, men of might, seventeen thousand and two hundred, going forth to war with might.

translations.ron: Toţi aceşti fii ai lui Iediael (Aşbel), au fost capi de familie, oameni războinici; şaptesprezece mii şi două sute erau în stare de a ieşi la război.
translations.grk: Πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ ʼΙεδιὴλ, ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, ἑπτα καίδεκα χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι, ἐκπορευόμενοι δυνάμει πολεμεῖν.

verses.translation: And Sapphin, and Apphin, and the sons of Or, Asom, whose son was Aor.

translations.ron: Şupim şi Hupim erau fiii lui Ir, iar Huşim era fiul lui Aher.
translations.grk: Καὶ Σαπφὶν, καὶ Ἀπφὶν, καὶ υἱοὶ Ὢρ, ʼΑσὼμ, υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ἀόρ.

verses.translation: The sons of Nephthali; Jasiel, Goni, and Aser, and Sellum, his sons, Balam his son.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Neftali au fost: Iahţiel, Guni, Ieţer şi Şalum (Silem), copiii Bilhei.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Νεφθαλὶ, Ἰασιὴλ, Γωνὶ, καὶ Ἀσὴρ, καὶ Σελλοὺμ, υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ, Βαλὰμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: The sons of Manasse; Esriel, whom his Syrian concubine bore; and she bore to him also Machir the father of Galaad.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Manase au fost: Asriel, pe care l-a născut concubina sa arameană; tot aceasta a născut pe Machir, tatăl lui Galaad.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Μανασσῆ, Ἐσριὴλ, ὃν ἔτεκεν ἡ παλλακὴ αὐτοῦ ἡ Σύρα, ἔτεκε δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ Μαχὶρ πατέρα Γαλαάδ.

verses.translation: And Machir took a wife for Apphin and Sapphin, and his sister's name was Moöcha; and the name of the second son was Sapphaad; and to Sapphaad were born daughters.

translations.ron: Machir şi-a luat de femeie pe sora lui Hupim şi a lui Şupim, al cărei nume era Maaca. Numele fiului al doilea a fost Salfaad. Salfaad a avut numai fete.
translations.grk: Καὶ Μαχὶρ ἔλαβε γυναῖκα τῷ Ἀπφὶν καὶ Σαπφίν· καὶ ὄνομα ἀδελφῆς αὐτοῦ Μοωχὰ, καὶ ὄνομα τῷ δευτέρῳ Σαπφαάδ· ἐγεννήθησαν δὲ τῷ Σαπφαὰδ θυγατέρες.

verses.translation: And Moöcha the wife of Machir bore a son, and called his name Phares; and his brother's name was Surus; his sons were Ulam, and Rocom.

translations.ron: Maaca, femeia lui Machir, a născut un fiu şi i-a pus numele Pereş, iar numele fratelui lui era Şereş. Fiii acestuia au fost Ulam şi Rechem.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔτεκε Μοωχὰ γυνὴ Μαχὶρ υἱὸν, καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Φαρές· καὶ ὄνομα ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ Σοῦρος· υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ Οὐλὰμ, καὶ ʼΡοκόμ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ulam; Badam. These were the sons of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasse.

translations.ron: Fiul lui Ulam a fost Bedan. Aceştia sunt fiii lui Galaad, fiul lui Machir, fiul lui Manase.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Οὐλὰμ, Βαδάμ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Γαλαὰδ, υἱοῦ Μαχὶρ, υἱοῦ Μανασσῆ.

verses.translation: And his sister Malecheth bore Isud, and Abiezer, and Maela.

translations.ron: Sora sa, Molechet, a născut pe Işhod, pe Abiezer şi pe Mahla.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ ἀδελφὴ αὐτοῦ ἡ Μαλεχὲθ ἔτεκε τὸν Ἰσοὺδ, καὶ τὸν Ἀβιέζερ, καὶ τὸν Μαελά.

verses.translation: And the sons of Semira were, Aim, and Sychem, and Lakim, and Anian.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Şemida au fost: Ahian, Şechem, Lichi şi Aniam.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Σεμιρὰ, ʼΑῒμ, καὶ Συχὲμ, καὶ Λακὶμ, καὶ Ἀνιάν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ephraim; Sothalath, and Barad his son, and Thaath his son, Elada his son, Saath his son,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Efraim au fost: Şutelah, Bered, fiul lui; Tahat, fiul lui; Eleadah, fiul lui şi Tahat, fiul lui;
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἐφραὶμ, Σωθαλὰθ, καὶ Βαρὰδ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ Θαὰθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, ʼΕλαδὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Σαὰθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,

verses.translation: and Zabad his son, Sothele his son, and Azer, and Elead: and the men of Geth who were born in the land slew them, because they went down to take their cattle.

translations.ron: Zabad, fiul lui; Şutelah, fiul lui; Ezer şi Elead. Pe aceştia i-au ucis locuitorii din Gat, băştinaşii jării aceleia, pentru că ei se duseseră să le apuce turmele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Ζαβὰδ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Σωθελὲ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ʼΑζὲρ, καὶ ʼΕλεάδ· καὶ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτοὺς οἱ ἄνδρες Γὲθ οἱ τεχθέντες ἐν τῇ γῇ, ὅτι κατέβησαν τοῦ λαβεῖν τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And their father Ephraim mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

translations.ron: După ei a plâns Efraim, tatăl lor, zile multe şi au venit fraţii lui să-l mângâie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπένθησεν Ἐφραὶμ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν ἡμέρας πολλάς· καὶ ἦλθον ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ τοῦ παρακαλέσαι αὐτόν.

verses.translation: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beria, because, said he, He was afflicted in my house.

translations.ron: Apoi a intrat el la femeia sa şi ea a zămislit şi a născut un fiu şi el i-a pus numele Beria, pentru că nenorocirea se atinsese de casa lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσῆλθε πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐν γαστρὶ, καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱόν· καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Βεριὰ, ὅτι ἐν κακοῖς ἐγένετο ἐν οἴκῳ μου.

verses.translation: And his daughter was Saraa, and he was among them that were left, and he built Bæthoron the upper and the lower. And the descendants of Ozan were Seera,

translations.ron: Şi a avut el şi o fată: Şeera. Aceasta a zidit Bethoronul de jos şi de sus şi Uzen-Şeera.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτοῦ Σαραά· καὶ ἐν ἐκείνοις τοῖς καταλοίποις· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησε τὴν Βαιθωρὼν τὴν κάτω καὶ τὴν ἄνω· καὶ υἱοὶ Ὀζὰν Σεηρὰ,

verses.translation: and Raphe his son, Saraph and Thalees his sons, Thaen his son.

translations.ron: Refah, fiul său, şi Reşef, fiul său; Telah, fiul său, şi Tahan, fiul său.
translations.grk: καὶ Ῥαφὴ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Σαρὰφ καὶ Θαλεὲς υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ, Θαὲν υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: To Laadan his son was born his son Amiud, his son Helisamai, his son

translations.ron: Ladan, fiul său; Amiud, fiul său, şi Elişama, fiul său.
translations.grk: Τῷ Λααδὰν υἱῷ αὐτοῦ υἱὸς Ἀμιοὺδ, υἱὸς Ἐλισαμαῒ,

verses.translation: Nun, his son Jesue, these were his sons.

translations.ron: Non, fiul său; Iosua, fiul său.
translations.grk: υἱὸς Νοὺν, υἱὸς Ἰησουὲ, υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And their possession and their dwelling were Bæthel and her towns, to the east Noaran, westward Gazer and her towns, and Sychem and her towns, as far as Gaza and her towns.

translations.ron: Moşiile lor şi locurile lor de locuit au fost: Betelul şi cetăţile care ţineau de el, spre răsărit Naaranul, spre apus Ghezerul şi cetăţile care ţineau de el; Sichemul şi cetăţile care ţineau de el până la Gaza şi cetăţile ce ţineau de aceasta.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατάσχεσις αὐτῶν καὶ κατοικία αὐτῶν Βαιθὴλ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, κατʼ ἀνατολὰς Νοαρὰν, πρὸς δυσμαῖς Γάζερ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, καὶ Συχὲμ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς ἕως Γάζης, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς,

verses.translation: And as far as the borders of the sons of Manasse, Bæthsaan and her towns, Thanach and her towns, Mageddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In this the children of Joseph the son of Israel dwelt.

translations.ron: Iar din partea fiilor lui Manase: Bet-Şeanul şi cetăţile ce ţineau de el, Taanacul şi cetăţile ce ţineau de el, Meghidonul şi cetăţile ce ţineau de el, Dorul şi cetăţile ce ţineau de el. în ele locuiau fiii lui Iosif, fiul lui Israel.
translations.grk: καὶ ἕως ὁρίων υἱῶν Μανασσῆ, Βαιθσαὰν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, Θανὰχ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, Μαγεδδὼ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, Δὼρ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς· ἐν ταύτῃ κατῴκησαν υἱοὶ Ἰωσὴφ υἱοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: The sons of Aser; Jemna, and Suia, and Isui, and Beria, and Sore their sister.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Aşer erau: Imna, Işva, Işvi şi Beria şi sora lor Serah.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἀσὴρ, Ἰεμνὰ, καὶ Σουΐα, καὶ Ἰσουῒ, καὶ Βεριὰ, καὶ Σορὲ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Beria; Chaber, and Melchiel; he was the father of Berthaith.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Beria au fost: Heber şi Malchiel. Acesta e tatăl lui Birzait.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Βεριὰ, Χάβερ, καὶ Μελχιήλ· οὗτος πατὴρ Βερθαΐθ.

verses.translation: And Chaber begot Japhlet, and Samer, and Chothan, and Sola their sister.

translations.ron: Heber a avut fii pe Iaflet, Şemer şi Hotam şi pe sora lor Şua.
translations.grk: Καὶ Χάβερ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰαφλὴτ, καὶ τὸν Σαμὴρ, καὶ τὸν Χωθὰν, καὶ τὴν Σωλὰ ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Japhlet; Phasec, and Bamael, and Asith: these are the sons of Japhlet.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iaflet au fost: Pasac, Bimhal şi Aşvat. Aceştia sunt fiii lui Iaflet.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰαφλὴτ, Φασὲκ, καὶ Βαμαὴλ, καὶ Ἀσίθ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἰαφλήτ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Semmer; Achir, and Rooga, and Jaba, and Aram.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Şemer au fost: Ahi, Rohga, Huba şi Aram.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Σεμμὴρ, Ἀχὶρ, καὶ Ῥοογὰ, καὶ ʼΙαβὰ, καὶ Αρὰμ,

verses.translation: And the sons of Elam his brother; Sopha, and Imana, and Selles, and Amal.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Helem, fratele lui, au fost: Ţofah, Imna, Şeleş şi Amal.
translations.grk: καὶ Βανὴ ʼΕλὰμ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ Σωφὰ, καὶ ʼΙμανὰ, καὶ Σελλὴς, καὶ ʼΑμάλ.

verses.translation: The sons of Sopha; Sue, and Arnaphar, and Suda, and Barin, and Imran,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ţofah au fost: Suah, Harnefer, Şual, Beri, Imra,
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σωφὰς, Σουὲ, καὶ Ἁρναφὰρ, καὶ Σουδὰ, καὶ Βαρὶν, καὶ ʼΙμρὰν,

verses.translation: and Basan, and Oa, and Sama, and Salisa, and Jethra, and Beëra.

translations.ron: Beţer, Hod, Şama, Şilşa, Itran şi Beera.
translations.grk: καὶ Βασὰν, καὶ ʼΩὰ, καὶ Σαμὰ, καὶ Σαλισὰ, καὶ ʼΙεθρὰ, καὶ Βεηρά.

verses.translation: And the sons of Jether, Jephina, and Phaspha, and Ara.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ieter au fost: Iefune, Pispa şi Ara.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰεθὴρ, Ἰεφινὰ, καὶ Φασφὰ, καὶ Ἀρά.

verses.translation: And the sons of Ola; Orech, Aniel, and Rasia.

translations.ron: Fiii născuţi din Ula au fost: Arah, Haniel şi Riţia.
translations.grk: καὶ υἱοὶ ʼΟλὰ, Ὀρὲχ, Ἀνιὴλ, καὶ Ῥασιά.

verses.translation: All these were the sons of Aser, all heads of families, choice, mighty men, chief leaders: their number for battle array—their number was twenty-six thousand men.

translations.ron: Toţi aceştia sunt fiii lui Aşer, capi de familie, oameni aleşi, războinici, căpetenii de mâna întâi. În tăbliţele lor cu spiţa neamului sunt înscrişi în oştire pentru război un număr de douăzeci şi şase de mii de oameni.
translations.grk: Πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀσὴρ, πάντες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν, ἐκλεκτοὶ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, ἄρχοντες ἡγούμενοι· ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν εἰς παράταξιν τοῦ πολεμεῖν, ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ἄνδρες εἰκοσιὲξ χιλιάδες.
